Author: Khloe Leclair
Name: Gearset Helper Plugin
Punchline: Display estimated stats with Examine, and export gear to Etro/Ariyala.
Description: Displays extra information about a character's gearsets when Examine is open, and makes it easy to export gearsets to Etro or Ariyala. Taiwan client port for yanmucorp Dalamud API 13 / XIVTCLauncher. Not for official international API 14 or 15.
